rootCauses.explanation: commons-lang 2.6 StringEscapeUtils.escapeSql was removed from the commons-lang3 family; after the coordinate migration to org.apache.commons:commons-lang3:3.14.0 the imported org.apache.commons.lang.StringEscapeUtils type no longer exists and the call site cannot compile.

javac names the removed TYPE (StringEscapeUtils), not the method: with lang3 the whole org.apache.commons.lang package is absent, so the import fails before the method is checked. The repair must remove the import, not swap the package.

suggestedActions.detail: replace the StringEscapeUtils.escapeSql call with a local escape implementation that doubles single quotes
